title: Pay the waste levy on waste received
what: Pay the EPA a waste levy for each tonne of waste received at premises subject to the levy (such as a landfill).

sources.title: Environment Protection Act 2017 (Vic)
sources.publisher: Victorian Legislation (authorised version saved by the owner)
sources.locator: s 145(1) (authorised version 023, saved by the owner)
sources.quote: A liable person must pay to the Authority a waste levy for each tonne of waste (other than priority waste) that is received at premises subject to the waste levy
